role: The single path that takes a recording off the strap: stop (H10 or Verity Sense), finalize wait, bounded download with retry/link-reset, date selection, cancel, and settling PolarManager recording state; also the reconnect-for-transfer helper and the inline end-of-session H10 stop.
types: StrapRecordingCoordinator: extension — fetch/stop/download/retry/cancel of strap-memory recordings
StrapTransferHandle: struct — id + cancel closure for the currently running transfer phase (stored on PolarManager.activeTransfer)
StrapRecordingSelection: enum — .newest(since:) or .exercise(id:) selection of which strap recording to download (an .exercise selection names nothing on a Verity Sense)
toplevel: StrapTransferHandle.id defaults to UUID() at construction (StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift:490). Conditional `import PolarBleSdk`. The coordinator mutates PolarManager state: mem:PolarManager.fetchCancelled, mem:PolarManager.activeTransfer, mem:PolarManager.transfersInFlight, mem:PolarManager.recordingState, mem:PolarManager.isRecordingOnDevice, mem:PolarManager.hasStoredExercise, mem:PolarManager.storedExerciseDate, mem:PolarManager.fetchProgress, and the download ledger ud:strapDownloadedRecordingStarts.

units.does: Public entry: downloads the newest strap recording that started at/after `recordedSince` (or newest of all when nil) under `budget`, by delegating to the private selection-based fetchRecording with .newest(since:).
Downloads one H10 exercise by stored id (the pre-arming rescue) by delegating to the private fetchRecording with .exercise(id:).

Core fetch: requires strap API, device id and .connected, increments transfersInFlight for the duration, runs the stop phase (stopRunningRecording) under budget.stopSeconds and the download phase (downloadWithRetries) under budget.downloadSeconds via runBounded, then noteDownloaded and returns the StrapRecording; any error is passed through settleFailedTransfer and rethrown.

branches.cond: no strap API, no connected device id, or connectionState != .connected
branches.effect: throws PolarError.notConnected before anything runs; otherwise proceeds to stop + download

branches.cond: catch of any error from stop/download/noteDownloaded
branches.effect: settleFailedTransfer resets progress/state and maps cancellation to fetchFailed("Cancelled by user"); the mapped error is rethrown

branches.effect: true: proceed to fetch; false (.notConnected/.skipVeritySenseNotRecording): log "Strap download skipped" and return nil

branches.effect: true: tail tells the user to recover from Record screen before starting anything; false: tail says the live stream is scored instead

units.does: Clears PolarManager.fetchCancelled so a new transfer flow starts uncancelled; called by every flow before its reconnect/fetch.

units.does: Runs one transfer phase inside its own Task raced against StrapDeadline (seconds, timeout error fetchFailed "strap <phase> timed out"), registers a StrapTransferHandle on PolarManager.activeTransfer so Cancel can end it, propagates caller cancellation to the task, and clears the handle when done if it is still the current one.

units.does: After a failed transfer: clears fetchProgress, forces recordingState to .idle if it is not, and returns either the original error (logged as a failure) or, when the error is a CancellationError or fetchCancelled is set, PolarError.fetchFailed("Cancelled by user"); a failure other than the cancellation that came after the Cancel (a phase deadline) is named in the cancellation log line.
